not: the hands stay extended for whichever Preface is read, and nothing in this scene changes.

BELL AC1 ×None — One ring at each 'Sanctus' of the Sanctus, in the established
UNRESOLVED: The total number of rings AC1 gives at the Sanctus belongs to the established
Sanctus serving profile. The approved record fixes only that AC1 rings at each 'Sanctus' and
names no count, so `count` is left null and no number is supplied from any other source.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,

The warning cue before the Consecration

BELL AC1 ×1 — The warning cue shortly before the Consecration, distinct from
every ring of the Consecration itself.
UNRESOLVED: The exact word of the Canon at which AC1 gives the warning cue belongs to the
serving profile. The approved record fixes only that it falls shortly before the Consecration
and that it is a distinct cue, so no text cue is pinned here.
